nonBlockingObservations.title: Carry the accepted qualification on allocation-free name copies into the inventory descriptions
nonBlockingObservations.description: Both new platform descriptions repeat the unconditional claim that no primitive allocates. CI2-R2-NBO-1 already records that invalid_input and supported_io construct message-carrying io::Error values on rejection paths, while the counting-allocator control covers successful name-bearing operations and selected refusals. Stack copies eliminate the unfunded native-name copies, but these statements overstate the all-path allocation guarantee and test coverage. This is the same non-blocking wording issue carried by the accepted code review and lead assent; it does not reopen the code unit or invalidate inventory coverage.
nonBlockingObservations.requestedChange: Qualify the descriptions to state that native name/path/target copies use stack storage and that the allocator control verifies the exercised operations; distinguish error-carrier allocation on refusal paths.
